01 — The ball

Match-grade, thirty-two panels

Twelve pentagons, twenty hexagons, one welded shell. The model turning here is the agency’s own, read straight from the supplied mesh rather than rebuilt from a primitive.

02 — The strike

Contact, and everything opens

A right-footed centre-forward puts his laces through it. At the moment of contact the shell comes apart along its seams and the panels carry their own construction outward.

03 — The player

Mehdi Taremi, Olympiacos

Seventy-nine caps for Iran and forty-three goals in them. Porto in 2020, Inter on a free in 2024, Olympiacos since August 2025.
